notablePrerequisites: All modes but "Abandon Ship" have been chosen for Kobayashi Maru Scenario.
easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to untap Daring Thief.
An opponent must control a permanent that shares a type with the one you wish to exchange.
description:
Untap Daring Thief using any method. It triggers, exchanging control of a permanent an opponent controls and Kobayashi Maru Scenario.
At the beginning of that opponent's upkeep, they are forced to choose the "Abandon Ship" mode and lose the game.
